data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Murkhis means 'The Gatherer'. This name holds a significant spiritual meaning in Islam as it symbolizes the person who gathers knowledge and wisdom from various sources and shares it with others for the betterment of society. The name Murkhis carries the meaning “The Gatherer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murkhis usually hope their child will grow to embody the gatherer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Murkhis belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Gatherer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murkhis total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
